Name: MH Skill Unlock History
Author: mahsouto
Description:
[size=6][b][center][/center][/b][/size][b] [center][size=6]MH Skill Unlock History[/size][/center][/b]
A comprehensive two-phase menu system that lets you view all your skill level rewards, including crafting recipes, cooking recipes, and level benefits. Press F5 to open and explore everything you've unlocked!

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Two-phase intuitive menu system
[list]
[*]Level List: Browse all unlocked levels from all your skills
[*]Level Details: Click any level to see its specific rewards and benefits
[/list][*]Full support for modded skills via SpaceCore integration
[*]Detailed information display
[list]
[*]Crafting and Cooking recipes with large item icons
[*]Recipe type labels (Crafting/Cooking)
[*]Level benefits and stat bonuses
[*]Profession choices at levels 5 and 10
[*]Experience requirements and progress tracking
[/list][*]Customizable hotkey (F5 by default)
[/list]
